messages.subject: opening this ropengov forum?
messages.body_plain: I noticed that our rOpenGov G+ discussion forum is privately shared. I propose we open the list for public as this is meant to be a generic support forum.

messages.body_plain:
Hi Leo,

Do you mean Google Group, and not G+?   If you are talking about this Google Group forum, I think it makes sense to open up to public. We've advertised the ropensci forum a lot lately and we've gotten many new members on the forum.

Cheers, Scott
